--the love quarrels between two ants, husband and wife, the husband having given pieces of मोदक to some other she ant, the wife ant resented, the husband repented and promised to behave better in future;
1: M. २०. ३९.
march- ing north they forebode evil.
2: Ib. २३८. 7.
--a son of Mitra and रेवती. भा. VI. १८. 6. [page२-333+ २७]
--a R. of the भारतवर्ष from the ऋक्ष hill. Br. II. १६. ३०. वा. ४५. १००.
--a son of र्षभ, a sage and a भागवत; called the attention of Nimi to नारायण as Brahman. भा.
